name: Lost Farm | 200mg Live Rosin Gummies | Tropical Lemonade
description: With tones of tropical tree fruit on a thick, earthy background, the indica-dominant Papaya strain also produces a spicy, peppery finish. Frozen lemonade flavors topped off with tropical tones of pineapple and mango are balanced with the Papaya strain’s earthy rosin notes.
